_comment: Reviewed merges into general predicates, some with swapped arguments (argumentOrder). Applied with: npm run consolidate -- --plan metadata/consolidation-plans/02-general.json

groups.rationale: A venue giving an artist an exhibition, or an artist having a space's first exhibition, is the artist exhibiting there; arguments swapped to (Artist, Venue).
A writer writing about a work is the work being reviewed by that writer; arguments swapped to (Work, Writer).
A person establishing an initiative is the initiative being founded by them; arguments swapped to (Initiative, Person).
Both say where a venue or organisation is; venue_in_area's arguments swapped to (Venue, Area). The place becomes an atom.
Serving on an organisation's council or being a founding member are both membership.
All relate a person to an organisation or department they led (as director, head, chair or president).
Both relate a person to a job title, given as text.
Both relate a work to a place or object shown in it (used_in_work already takes the work first despite its name).
All record the year an organisation, work or project began (started_by's second argument is a year, not a founder).
All relate an organisation to premises it used or rented; arguments swapped to (Organisation, Premises).
All relate a person to an institution, lab or company whose facilities or equipment they used.
City and country are kinds of place; one class keeps place atoms in one predicate.
All relate a work to a medium, format, technique or material it uses; the text values become atoms like the rest of uses_medium.
All relate a work or person to equipment, technology or software used (year_started_using_technology records no year); values become atoms.
